svg.title: Chobundo process evidence
svg.desc: Named Chobundo model pages support thin-wall casting, one-use mould descriptions, handmade spouts, and baked lacquer coloring. They do not establish a universal dry-mould route.
svg.text: Chobundo: strong named-model evidence, no universal mould label
• named models: mould made once, not reused
Model records, not a historical production archive.
Do not state: every Chobundo kettle = dry mould
Do not infer: exact core route or fitting history
Do not use surface as a maker mark
“Made once” does support a one-use mould context.
The right technical claim is the documented one: thin walls, named one-use moulds, spout, and lacquer finish.
